newsitem.title: CANADA: Cascades unit to invest C$120 million.
newsitem.headline: Cascades unit to invest C$120 million.

text.p: Cascades Inc unit Perkins Papers Ltd. said on Thursday that it plans to invest C$120 million over the next three years.

The investments include C$90 million to increase total tissue manufacturing capacity by 30 percent (53,000 tons a year) and to increase converting capacity. The balance of the investments will serve to maintain and improve the operating efficiencies of the company's existing equipment, it said.
The investments include C$37 million in Rockingham, N.C., C$42 million in Kingsey Falls, $17 million in Lachute, C$18 million in Candiac, and C$6 million in Laval, all in Quebec.

The increased tissue manufacturing capacity will be achieved through the up-grade and speed-up of existing paper machines in Quebec, by adding, in 1998, a new tissue paper machine in Rockingham producing 25,000 tons a year, and by the installation of additional de-inking capacity.
The increase in converting capacity will be achieved through the installation of four new converting lines.

Perkins Papers Ltd said it is Canada's second-largest maker and converter of tissue paper, and has annual sales of C$250 million. It operates seven paper machines with a total capacity of 200,000 tons.
